events.title: Estimated tax payment Q3 2026 (Form 1040-ES)
events.desc: Federal estimated tax for income earned June 1 to August 31, 2026. Pay with IRS Direct Pay, EFTPS or your IRS online account. Most states with an income tax use the same dates.

events.title: Extended 2025 tax return due
events.desc: Last day to file your 2025 Form 1040 if you requested an extension.

events.title: Estimated tax payment Q4 2026 (Form 1040-ES)
events.desc: Federal estimated tax for income earned September 1 to December 31, 2026. Pay with IRS Direct Pay, EFTPS or your IRS online account. Most states with an income tax use the same dates.

events.title: Send Form 1099-NEC to contractors and the IRS
events.desc: For each contractor you paid $2,000 or more in 2026 (the threshold was $600 for 2025 payments). January 31 falls on a Sunday, so the deadline moves to February 1.

events.title: Your 1099-NEC and 1099-K forms should have arrived
events.desc: Clients and payment platforms must send them by this date. Check them against your own records before filing.

events.title: 2026 tax return and balance due (Form 1040, Schedule C and SE)
events.desc: File your return and pay any tax owed, or file Form 4868 for an automatic six-month extension to file (not to pay). Also the last day for 2026 IRA and HSA contributions.

events.title: Estimated tax payment Q1 2027 (Form 1040-ES)
events.desc: Federal estimated tax for income earned January 1 to March 31, 2027. Pay with IRS Direct Pay, EFTPS or your IRS online account. Most states with an income tax use the same dates.

events.title: Estimated tax payment Q2 2027 (Form 1040-ES)
events.desc: Federal estimated tax for income earned April 1 to May 31, 2027. Pay with IRS Direct Pay, EFTPS or your IRS online account. Most states with an income tax use the same dates.

events.title: Estimated tax payment Q3 2027 (Form 1040-ES)
events.desc: Federal estimated tax for income earned June 1 to August 31, 2027. Pay with IRS Direct Pay, EFTPS or your IRS online account. Most states with an income tax use the same dates.

events.title: Extended 2026 tax return due
events.desc: Last day to file your 2026 Form 1040 with an extension. SEP-IRA contributions for 2026 can be made until this date.

events.title: Estimated tax payment Q4 2027 (Form 1040-ES)
events.desc: Federal estimated tax for income earned September 1 to December 31, 2027. Pay with IRS Direct Pay, EFTPS or your IRS online account. Most states with an income tax use the same dates.
